items.title: What Does Equinix (EQIX) Gain From Fabric One, atNorth, And Quantum Infrastructure?
items.summary: Equinix (NasdaqGS: EQIX) launched Equinix Fabric One, a managed connectivity service for cloud, AI, and networking environments. The company completed its acquisition of atNorth, expanding its data center presence in the Nordic region. Diraq deployed a quantum computer in an Equinix data center, creating an industry first by integrating quantum, AI, and classical computing infrastructure.
